name: Move Payment
author: movepayment

sections.description:
Move Payment plugin allows WooCommerce store owners to accept payments securely and efficiently. The plugin integrates Move Payment services with your WooCommerce store, ensuring that all transactions are processed smoothly, with funds transferred directly to your bank account. Save money on every transaction with our competitive rates.

  • Seamless WooCommerce integration: Works out of the box with WooCommerce to handle payments.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external service to process payments:

  • Service Name: MovePay API
  • URL: https://api.dev-movepay.devdemo.it
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy

License
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/move-payment directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and enable the Move Payment method.
  4. Configure your Move Payment credentials and other necessary settings in the plugin settings page.
